name: Western Front
funding: 2025-26: Canada Council, BC Arts Council, Province of BC and City of Vancouver, with the Audain Foundation and Western Front Foundation at $20k+.
watch: One of Canada's oldest artist-run centres, founded in 1973 by eight artists in a Knights of Pythias hall. The building was bought in 2015 with C$1.5M of developer Rize's city amenity money.
records_note: Western Front posts annual reports for 2021 to 2026 with audited-statement summaries, a named 2025-26 supporter list and its board.

name: 1 Shanthiroad Studio Gallery
funding: Arts Council grants, philanthropic educational trusts, founder endowment; non-profit artist initiative.
watch: Founded by art historian Suresh Jayaram. An open courtyard space in Bangalore for independent residencies and botanical research.

name: 21st Century Museum of Contemporary Art
funding: Municipal, run by the Kanazawa Art Promotion Foundation.
watch: Attendance is widely reported above 1M a year.
why_flagged: Gold member Kanazawa Energy is a city-gas utility, 48% Hokuriku Electric and 43% Toho Gas. Iwatani Central Hokuriku (LPG) also listed. No protest found.
records_note: Kanazawa 21 posts its 2025 annual report and names its supporting members by tier undated, but publishes no accounts or board.

name: 421 Arts Campus (formerly Warehouse421)
funding: Opened 2015 in Mina Zayed as part of the Salama bint Hamdan Al Nahyan Foundation, a royal private foundation, with education and university programme partners
watch: Space for emerging artists, outside the big state museums. The backing foundation belongs to the UAE president's wife, Salama bint Hamdan.
records_note: It posts a 2021 to 2022 review and a 2023 study but no accounts; its partners page names sponsors from older projects without a date.

name: 49 Nord 6 Est – Frac Lorraine
funding: French state (DRAC) and Région Grand Est; patron list unreadable.
records_note: Lists its board of directors in a 2025 booklet on its site; patron names are not published, and no annual reports or accounts are posted.

name: A. Kasteyev State Museum of Arts
watch: Now styled the Abilkhan Kasteev National Museum of Art. 2021 noise dispute with Esentai luxury housing.
records_note: Its old site posted narrative annual reports for 2017 to 2019 without accounts; the new site was unreadable.

name: ABC No Rio
funding: Grassroots community donations, NYSCA, NYC DCLA, member volunteer dues; 501(c)(3) non-profit.

name: Ackland Art Museum
funding: UNC unit, about 60k visitors a year; Ackland bequest, university, Mellon, Luce and Kenan Trust; Bank of America is the one corporate sponsor.
watch: Ackland's fortune is said to have come from Isaac Franklin's slave trading; this is not confirmed.
records_note: A UNC unit: annual reports for fiscal 2023 to 2025 show a budget and donors; UNC posts the audited accounts, and advisory boards are listed.

name: Addis Foto Fest
funding: Produced by Desta for Africa, directed by Aida Muluneh. The last sponsor list is from 2018: Swiss Embassy, Canon, National Geographic Society, Marriott and others. None published since.
watch: Founded 2010. The fifth edition opened 6 December 2018. A sixth was announced for December 2020; no edition since is documented.
records_note: addisfotofest.com lists no sponsors, reports, accounts or board; it posts festival catalogues for 2010 to 2018 and names Desta for Africa as producer.

name: Akademie Schloss Solitude
funding: A public-law foundation run and financed by the state of Baden-Württemberg; programme partners include KfW Stiftung and Robert Bosch GmbH.
watch: State-founded residency (1990) in a baroque palace. It runs a code of conduct for fellows, introduced after an Oct 2023 open letter.
records_note: Solitude names its foundation board and trustees, but posts no annual reports, accounts or funder list; project partners are credited on programme pages.

name: Al Ma'mal Foundation for Contemporary Art
funding: European Cultural Foundation, Prince Claus Fund, Swedish International Development Cooperation; non-profit foundation.
watch: Non-profit foundation promoting cultural life from a 1900 tile factory inside New Gate, in Jerusalem's Old City.
records_note: Al Ma'mal shows donor logos with no dates, publishes no reports or accounts, and names its board of directors and General Assembly.

name: Al Riwaq Art Space
watch: Bahrain's longest-running independent contemporary art space, now a non-profit hub with studios, a library and a cafe.
records_note: Al Riwaq publishes no annual reports, accounts, sponsor list or board; its partnerships page names only an events collaborator.
